SELECT i.id AS knowledgeId, i.organ_id AS organId, i.category_id AS categoryId, i.knowledge_key AS knowledgeKey, i.knowledge_name AS knowledgeName, i.knowledge_type AS knowledgeType, i.description AS description, i.visibility AS visibility, r.active_revision_id AS activeRevisionId, v.revision_no AS revisionNo
ORDER BY i.update_time DESC, i.id DESC LIMIT #{limit, jdbcType=INTEGER} OFFSET #{offset, jdbcType=INTEGER}

SELECT i.organ_id AS organId, i.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, COUNT(1) AS knowledgeCount FROM knowledge_item i INNER JOIN knowledge_release r ON r.knowledge_id = i.id AND r.organ_id = i.organ_id AND (r.delete_flag = 0 OR r.delete_flag IS NULL) AND r.release_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND r.active_revision_id IS NOT NULL INNER JOIN knowledge_revision v ON v.id = r.active_revision_id AND v.organ_id = i.organ_id AND v.knowledge_id = i.id AND (v.delete_flag = 0 OR v.delete_flag IS NULL) AND v.revision_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND v.index_status = 'INDEXED' LEFT JOIN knowledge_category c ON c.id = i.category_id AND c.organ_id = i.organ_id AND (c.delete_flag = 0 OR c.delete_flag IS NULL) WHERE i.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND i.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (i.delete_flag = 0 OR i.delete_flag IS NULL) AND i.category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.organ_id, i.category_id, c.category_name ORDER BY knowledgeCount DESC, i.category_id ASC
